task.title: Persist exact recurrence occurrence provenance
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/875 by durably recording one immutable exact finite-recurrence coordinate without granting due or execution authority.
acceptance_criteria: Use a canonical collision-free stream identity for recurrence ID and zero-based offset, then persist exact projected provenance once.
Validate the authoritative definition, requested revision, finite coordinate, payload version, event discriminator, stream identity, and complete single-event replay history.
Return typed missing, stale, out-of-range, duplicate, read-only, and corruption evidence while keeping occurrence records inert.

attempts.diagnostic: Recurrence-store integration tests failed because occurrence persistence, exact loading, and their typed errors did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added persistence and reopen, coordinate isolation, duplicate and concurrent writes, validation, read-only, collision, and malformed-history tests.

attempts.diagnostic: Projected occurrences were reproducible but could not serve as durable provenance for later lifecycle slices without a canonical exact-coordinate record.
attempts.patch: Added versioned occurrence events, length-prefixed collision-free stream keys, strict exact replay, typed errors, authoritative projection validation, and ADR-0045.

attempts.summary: Hardened concurrency and corruption portability during review.
attempts.diagnostic: CodeRabbit found reliance on rusqlite's default busy timeout and SQLite's version-sensitive acceptance of JSON stored as BLOB in json_extract; it also suggested clearer stream and version contracts.
attempts.patch: Set an explicit five-second busy timeout, cast test payloads to text for JSON extraction, separated occurrence payload versioning, pinned length-prefix keys, guarded definition revision, resolved every thread, and obtained CodeRabbit's no-actionable-comments review summary for 43965d4 through exact head de56d31 after cooldown.

outcome.summary: Vela durably records and strictly reloads one immutable exact recurrence occurrence coordinate as inert provenance tied to its authoritative definition revision.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo run --locked -p vela-dev -- record validate corpus/development/0171-durable-recurrence-occurrence-provenance.json # result: valid development record
nix develop --command cargo run --locked -p vela-dev -- corpus inspect corpus/development # result: inspected 171 records: 171 valid, 0 invalid

lessons: Canonical composite stream keys need an injective encoding that remains safe when identifiers contain delimiters.
Persisted occurrence provenance must be checked against the authoritative definition and revision both before append and during replay.
Configure concurrency behavior explicitly and avoid version-sensitive SQLite BLOB-to-JSON assumptions.

CodeRabbit findings led to an explicit five-second busy timeout, text-cast SQLite JSON tests, separate occurrence payload versioning, pinned length-prefix stream keys, and guarded definition revision; every thread was resolved before exact-head re-review.
A persisted occurrence is evidence only; due policy, claims, materialization, dispatch, retries, and execution remain separate authority boundaries.
